<thought>To determine the number of methyl (CH₃) groups, I will obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample, which lists the distinct carbon environments. Methyl carbons typically appear in the upfield region (~10–30 ppm). By counting how many peaks fall in that range, I can infer the number of methyl groups present.</thought>
